title: Embodied Zero-Shot Task Planning via Hardware-Aware LLM-VLM Integration for Grounded Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can translate natural-language instructions into plausible manipulation plans, but robotic execution requires physically grounded decisions that respect robot embodiment, workspace geometry, reachability, collision constraints, and grasp feasibility. This paper presents a hardware-aware large language model-vision-language model (LLM-VLM) manipulation framework for a simulated Franka Research 3 robot in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The framework separates symbolic reasoning from metric execution: an API-hosted LLM planner receives a structured scene summary and generates only symbolic task information, including the object to manipulate, target relation, approach preference, and objects to avoid. A local Qwen3-VL 8B VLM verifier supports semantic confirmation of ambiguous objects and open-container surrogates. Both the LLM planner and the VLM verifier are prohibited from generating robot coordinates, grasp poses, keepout dim

translated_title: 基于硬件感知的LLM-VLM集成实现具身零样本任务规划，用于有物理依据的机器人操作
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够将自然语言指令转化为看似合理的操作规划，但机器人的实际执行需要基于物理的决策，这些决策必须尊重机器人的具身特性、工作空间几何、可达性、碰撞约束以及抓取可行性。本文提出了一种硬件感知的大语言模型-视觉语言模型（LLM-VLM）操作框架，应用于NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真环境中的Franka Research 3机器人。该框架将符号推理与度量执行相分离：由API托管的大语言模型规划器接收结构化的场景摘要，仅生成符号化的任务信息，包括待操作对象、目标关系、接近偏好以及需要避开的物体。本地部署的Qwen3-VL 8B视觉语言模型验证器用于支持对模糊对象和开放容器替代物进行语义确认。大语言模型规划器和视觉语言模型验证器均被禁止生成机器人坐标、抓取位姿、禁避区域尺寸……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种硬件感知的LLM-VLM集成框架，通过将大语言模型的符号任务推理与视觉语言模型的语义验证同机器人的度量执行相分离，使两者不直接生成坐标和抓取位姿，从而实现了尊重机器人本体约束的零样本具身操作任务规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hardware-aware LLM-VLM integration framework that separates symbolic task reasoning (LLM planning) and semantic verification (VLM) from metric robot execution, prohibiting both models from generating coordinates and grasp poses, thereby achieving zero-shot embodied task planning grounded in robot embodiment constraints.
